body: U+0023222 merged (aa5bf95); local fast-forwarded, drive.sh untouched. Verification on the merged branch: flutter analyze clean; full suite 3408 of 3409 pass. The one failure, test/tooling/probe/macos_driver_test.dart 'undo cases type one U1 entry and press Move down itself', sources the owner's uncommitted tool/probe/macos/drive.sh; on a clean worktree of aa5bf95 all 29 tests in that file pass.U+000AOwner asked for live macOS checks that leave their keyboard and mouse 100% in their control. Answer given: 10.45 and 10.46 can run with no input on the Mac (AX reads and AX presses, open -g, never frontmost, no VoiceOver, no hid tool, reminder time seeded in the test build's own settings, a listen-only guard for software-made events and frontmost changes); the owner clicks Allow and Don't Allow on two test copies. 10.47 is phone-only. 10.48 Pinyin cannot run on the host without changing the global input source and feeding the input method from the input stream: options are owner types it while I observe, a macOS VM (Tart) with its own virtual keyboard, or skip. Unverified until run: whether an AX press on a background Flutter window brings it forward, and whether its AX tree updates while fully covered.
